project_summary: Knowledge worker's research repo. Goal: produce well-cited synthesis reports from a corpus of papers, web sources, and interview transcripts.
pattern_rationale: Per the research report, synthesis projects benefit from multiple researchers covering distinct sub-questions in parallel. A synthesizer specialist then merges. Evaluator-optimizer is wrapped on via the citation-checker since factual accuracy is gradeable.

agents.name: synth-lead
agents.responsibilities: Owns the synthesis task. Decomposes the user's question into 2–3 sub-questions, assigns one researcher per sub-question (parallel sectioning), then routes the assembled findings to synthesizer, then to citation-checker. Does not write the synthesis itself.
agents.trigger_phrase: Use for any question that requires consulting multiple sources and producing a synthesis report.
agents.stop_criteria: Synthesis report exists at output path, citation-checker has returned PASS, final summary delivered to user.

agents.name: primary-researcher
agents.responsibilities: Investigates the most central sub-question. Surveys the project's local corpus + authoritative external sources. Produces a structured findings doc with citations.
agents.trigger_phrase: Use for the primary sub-question of a synthesis task — the one carrying the most weight in the final answer.
agents.stop_criteria: Findings doc written to scratch_dir, summary sent to lead.

agents.name: secondary-researcher
agents.responsibilities: Investigates supporting sub-questions in parallel with primary-researcher. Same output format. Coordinates with primary to avoid duplicating sources.
agents.trigger_phrase: Use for secondary or supporting sub-questions that sit alongside the main question.
agents.stop_criteria: Findings doc written to scratch_dir, summary sent to lead.

agents.name: synthesizer
agents.responsibilities: Reads all researchers' findings. Writes the final synthesis report — coherent narrative, structured argument, all claims traceable to a researcher's finding. Does not invent claims; pure aggregation + framing.
agents.trigger_phrase: Use after all researchers have completed and the lead is ready to assemble the final report.
agents.stop_criteria: Synthesis report written, summary sent to lead.

agents.name: citation-checker
agents.responsibilities: Reads the synthesis report. For every claim, verifies the cited source actually says what the report claims. Spot-checks 100% of URL citations by fetching them; spot-checks a sample of local-file citations. Returns APPROVE / REVISE / BLOCK with specific defects.
agents.trigger_phrase: Use after synthesizer produces a draft, before delivering to user.

shared_context.claude_md_additions:
## Research synthesis team

5-agent parallel-sectioning team. Lead decomposes into sub-questions, two researchers work in parallel, synthesizer merges, citation-checker verifies.

Run: `/run-team <your research question>`
All claims must be cite-traceable. The citation-checker enforces this and will reject reports with unverifiable claims.
